description: Editing, deleting and excluding a speech clip.

preconditions: An existing sentence with audio; the actor is its speaker (active user).
cases.return: Success (200, MSG322); the row is removed and its audio file is deleted after the commit.
cases.log: Audit SpeechClipDeleted (sentence, meeting, speaker, byOwner true); a ClipDeleted change is published.

preconditions: An existing sentence of another speaker; the actor is the meeting's Secretary.
cases.return: Success (200, MSG322); the row and its audio are removed.
cases.log: Audit SpeechClipDeleted (byOwner false); a ClipDeleted change is published.

preconditions: An existing sentence; the actor is an active Member who is neither its speaker nor the Secretary.
An existing sentence with audio; the actor is its speaker.
The database fails while saving the removal.
cases.return: SaveFailed (503, MSG304); the row and its audio file are kept.
cases.log: Error log 'Failed to delete speech clip'.
